misconception_guards: Resolved F1 guard RF-U6-004: Use “typically” for cellular RNA/DNA structure. RNA often folds into paired regions, and some viral genomes depart from the usual cellular patterns.

Resolved F1 guard RF-U6-001: Preserve the classroom wording in the raw ledger. Canonically describe Franklin’s X-ray diffraction work as providing critical evidence for DNA’s helical structure and dimensions; do not imply she merely supplied a picture used by others.

Resolved F1 guard RF-U6-002: Retain the historical example as teacher enrichment, while avoiding an oversimplified discovery narrative. Their model-building incorporated multiple lines of evidence, including Franklin’s diffraction data and Chargaff’s composition rules.

Discrimination requirement U6-D01: keep DNA/RNA as hereditary information, Typical RNA versus DNA architecture, DNA antiparallel structural review, 5′ and 3′ end chemistry review physically and verbally distinct until the diagnostic comparison is complete.
